evidence.detail: The constructor sets RSInterface type aI to 2 and allocates the item-id, amount and per-slot metadata arrays used by inventory-style widgets.
The builder sizes the item/amount arrays from the requested slot count and exposes width/height-style grid sizing plus slot-spacing fields.
Instances register directly in the global RSInterface table under their interface id, making this a concrete inventory-grid widget rather than an external model.

evidence.detail: The factory creates a zero-child RSInterface container, initializes child id/x/y arrays and exposes width/height plus scroll-height state.
The class lazily owns the retained InterfaceLayoutManager and returns InterfaceLayoutEntry objects for child widgets by id.
Its finalization method delegates to InterfaceLayoutManager to resolve and write child positions back into the owning RSInterface.

evidence.detail: The factory sets RSInterface type aI to 5, the exact sprite widget type, and installs the same Sprite reference into the normal and alternate sprite fields.
Width and height are initialized from the sprite's intrinsic dimensions and can be explicitly overridden through the fluent size method.
Unlike the clickable/hover builders in the same package, this class adds no action or tooltip state beyond the sprite widget itself.
